newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 climbs to record intraday high.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 climbs to record intraday high.

text.p: The FTSE 100 of leading London shares scored a fresh all-time intraday high in early dealings on Monday, buoyed by a good performance on Wall Street on Friday and a strong opening in FTSE 100 futures and gilts.

At 0854 GMT, the blue chip index was up 10.6 points at 4,101.6 after rising as high as 4,103.1, while March futures were up 15.0 points at 4,114.0. Advancers beat decliners by margin of about seven to one.
The higher index came even after ex-dividends knocked 3.9 points off the calculation. Severn Trent Water, one of two FTSE 100 stocks trading ex-dividend, was the biggest loser.
